notes.title: Public Enemy is coming...
notes.content:
https://media.giphy.com/media/LkqktyNGWO3qlBd2cG/giphy.gif

Here is Public Enemy: Revolution Simulator!

This game was made during a game jam some years ago. We like it so much that we wanted to share it for free on Steam!

This short game is about dictatorship, but made in a funny way. Stick fishes on the back of the guards, make graffiti's in the city and break the statues of the government to raise the people, without being caught!

Wishlist it now to be ready for the Release Day!
This game will be totally free! 

See ya on Discord!
http://discord.gg/a3qtypa

Concretely,
Concrete Games Team
